neighbours.label: the token URL / url (a web address named as such), not 'address', 'link' or 'website'
fire: Brown, K. 2015. River birds of Peru. Ornithology Notes 12:33-40. Retrieved from URL: http://birds.example.net/
Before sharing the article, check that the URL starts with https.
The phishing email used a fake URL that looked like the bank's own site.
Copy the url of the video and paste it into the chat window.
